name: Pantrysrealm
description:
pantry's realm is a semi-vanilla Minecraft Bedrock survival server with achievements on, Hard mode, and a true forever world running since July 2024. Found a country, claim and protect land, and shape a player-run society through the in-game Realm Hub: territories and subdivisions, plots you can sell or rent, businesses and storefronts, a vanilla item-trade economy, teams, events, and a social feed. Transport is fully vanilla (no teleports, roads and bridges connect the realm), combat and trapping are on everywhere except the rare shared safezones, and everything is 100% free of pay-to-win. Java is not supported (Bedrock only).

Join: pantrysrealm.net

Port 9010

Discord: discord.gg/Xyfw3u7yWY

On console, add pantrysrealm as a friend and join from your friends list.
